SB 6231 - 2025-26
Revised for engrossed
: Removing a tax exemption for the replacement of equipment for data centers.
Revised for 1st Substitute
: Expiring tax exemptions for data centers.
Original
: Removing a tax exemption for the replacement of equipment for data centers.
By request:
Office of Financial Management
Companion bill:
HB 2708
